title: Value Portrait: Assessing Language Models’ Values through Psychometrically and Ecologically Valid Items
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured how LLMs associate different religious identities (personas) with Schwartz's basic human values. Specifically, it tested whether the model relates religiosity with the 'Tradition' value.
findings: The GPT-4o model understands the relationship between religious demographics and the 'Tradition' value. Prompting the model with an Atheist persona decreased its Tradition score, while prompting with Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, and Protestant personas increased Tradition scores, suggesting the model associates religiosity with traditional values, consistent with Schwartz's theory of basic values.
